content_sections.title: A short station story
content_sections.body_text: At 5:10, Mai was reading the station board when Linh called. Linh needed the bus number, time, and gate. Board: ‘Bus 12 leaves at 5:20 from Gate 4.’ Cover the story; name the action in progress and the three facts.

content_sections.title: Choose a suitable request
content_sections.body_text: Mai to unfamiliar staff: ‘Excuse me. Could you help me check the 5:20 departure and find Gate 4, please?’ Staff: ‘Yes. Bus 12 leaves at 5:20 from Gate 4.’ To a friend: ‘Can you check Gate 4 with me?’ The first is respectful to staff; the second suits a shared task with a friend. Choose for each person, explain why, and adapt a detail. In danger, state the need directly.

content_sections.title: Pass the answer to Linh
content_sections.body_text: Linh: ‘Which bus is it, when does it leave, and where do I go?’ Mai: ‘Bus 12 leaves at 5:20 from Gate 4.’ Linh: ‘Thanks.’ Mai read the board, confirmed the facts with staff, and passed them to Linh. Cover the dialogue, answer Linh, then uncover Mai’s reply to check.

content_sections.title: Stress STA and check by listening
content_sections.body_text: STA-tion has two beats; STA /steɪ/ is stronger. Say the second beat lightly. Record the story and both dialogues. Hide the text, replay, and answer: What was Mai doing? What did staff say? What did Mai tell Linh? Uncover and check: Mai was reading the board; staff said Bus 12 leaves at 5:20 from Gate 4; Mai told Linh the same sentence.
